title: Learning Record
description: Minimal shared record connecting the review and diagnostic skills to MetaBuilder retrospectives and the tool-ecosystem friction ledger. A record is a finding plus provenance plus a disposition; it is never controller evidence by itself.

finding.description: One concrete sentence: what was observed, not what should be done about the task.

rule_id.description: Shared diagnostic-taxonomy rule when the finding instantiates one.

evidence_refs.description: Paths, digests, or transcript references that locate the evidence.

target.description: Where the finding went: a metabuilder retrospective record, the friction ledger, or null when merely recorded.

promotion_contract.description: What must be true to promote this finding into a harness/module change or a tooling change.
